name: Defence (NDA / CDS)
description: Defence awareness for NDA, CDS and AFCAT exams.

questions.question: The National Defence Academy (NDA) is located at which place?
questions.explanation: NDA Khadakwasla near Pune trains tri-service cadets; the IMA (Dehradun), INA (Ezhimala) and AFA (Dundigal) train the individual services.

questions.question: Who was India's first Chief of Defence Staff (CDS), appointed in 2019?
options: Air Chief Marshal R. K. S. Bhadauria
questions.explanation: General Bipin Rawat became the first CDS on 1 January 2020 (post created 2019); he died in a helicopter crash in December 2021.

questions.question: Operation Vijay (1999) is the codename for which conflict?
questions.explanation: Operation Vijay (May–July 1999) evicted Pakistani intruders from the Kargil heights; 26 July is celebrated as Kargil Vijay Diwas.

questions.question: The Agnipath scheme (2022) recruits soldiers for what tenure, after which a share is retained?
questions.explanation: Agniveers serve 4 years; up to 25% can be enrolled into regular cadre after the term.

questions.question: MARCOS (Marine Commandos) is the special forces unit of which service?
questions.explanation: MARCOS is the Indian Navy's elite special operations unit; the Army has Para SF and the IAF has Garud.

questions.question: What is the motto of the Indian Air Force?
questions.explanation: The IAF's motto is 'Nabhah Sparsham Deeptam' — Touch the Sky with Glory. 'Service Before Self' is the Army's.

questions.question: Which Field Marshal, nicknamed 'Sam Bahadur', led India to victory in the 1971 war?
questions.explanation: Field Marshal Sam Manekshaw was Army Chief during the 1971 Bangladesh war; he and K. M. Cariappa are India's only Field Marshals.

questions.question: INS Vikrant (commissioned 2022) is notable for being what?
questions.explanation: INS Vikrant (IAC-1) is India's first indigenously designed and built aircraft carrier, built at Cochin Shipyard.

questions.question: Exercise Malabar is a naval exercise involving India and which three countries?
questions.explanation: Malabar began as an India–US exercise and now includes Japan and Australia as part of the Quad's military cooperation.

questions.question: Garud is the special forces unit of which service?
questions.explanation: The Garud Commando Force (2004) is the IAF's special operations unit for airfield seizure and rescue missions.

questions.question: Aero India 2025, Asia's premier aerospace exhibition, was held in which city?
questions.explanation: Aero India is held biennially at Air Force Station Yelahanka, Bengaluru.

questions.question: Which is India's highest wartime gallantry award?
questions.explanation: The Param Vir Chakra is the highest wartime gallantry award; the Ashoka Chakra is the highest peacetime gallantry award.

questions.question: Who was the first recipient of the Param Vir Chakra?
questions.explanation: Major Somnath Sharma received the first PVC (posthumous) for his defence of Badgam in the 1947–48 Kashmir war.

questions.question: India's nuclear tests of 1974 and 1998 were conducted at which site?
questions.explanation: Pokhran-I ('Smiling Buddha', 1974) and Pokhran-II (Operation Shakti, May 1998) were conducted in the Pokhran range of Rajasthan.

questions.question: The Rafale fighter jets operated by the IAF were purchased from which country?
questions.explanation: India bought 36 Rafale jets from Dassault (France) under a 2016 deal; the IAF also flies Sukhoi Su-30MKI and indigenous Tejas.
